title: Fig tree and asking for the great things
english: On the withered fig tree. Mark adds that seeing leaves from afar he came seeking fruit — it was not fig season — and said [[may no one ever eat fruit from you again >> Bible:Mark 11:14]]. The [[fruit of the Spirit >> Bible:Galatians 5:22-23]] is sometimes given in its own season; better still if, when circumstances push the other way, one still bears fruit because the Word has so helped. Jesus told the disciples: ask for the great things and the small will be added; ask for the heavenly and the earthly will be added.
translator_notes: True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B.
Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.

title: Temple cleansing and the question of authority
english: After the entry and the casting out of sellers from the temple, the chief priests ask [[by what authority >> Bible:Matthew 21:23]]. He counters with John’s baptism and exposes those unwilling to say whether it was from heaven or from humans. So the Word’s authority is plain to fruit-bearers and hidden to leaf-only trees. Glory to Christ. Amen.
